### Reconciliation rationale

The prior blocked receipt correctly failed closed because no independent reviewer identity had yet been bound. The subsequent attestation attempt returned `NOT_VERIFIED` only because the reviewer was asked to prove an unobservable universal negative across every historical chat context. That is not a documented requirement of the locked Parent PM Skill or state machine. The locked requirement is candidate-specific independence: the reviewer assigned to this exact candidate must not have authored, technically gated, deployed with repair authority, admitted, or governed the same candidate.

Under this project's GitHub-only durable-authority rule, Product Governance verifies that independence from durable actor/context separation and a fresh formal review context assignment. The formal reviewer context above is new, has no prior durable candidate-role record, is distinct from Engineering `ED-KK-GOAL01-PX02-DISCLOSURE-CORRECTION-R1-20260917-0925-D7A2`, Candidate Admission `PG-KK-GOAL01-PX02-SUCCESSOR-CANDIDATE-ADMISSION-20260917-1005-PG`, and all Product Governance contexts. The failed attestation context is not reused for the formal review.

This does not weaken the Product Experience gate: the formal reviewer must remain code-blind for verdict, operate the exact review artifact independently, produce fresh screenshots/interaction evidence, and may return PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED. Engineering assertions, prior reviewer findings, PG observations, Owner direction, and this eligibility decision cannot pre-write the verdict.
